completeFloraSupplement.size: Tiny, occupies a supported 5 ft square as a low plant; does not block traversal or grant cover; zeroSpeed and no voluntary movement. Can be carried only as an ordinary object-body interaction; lifting/uprooting ends it immediately without harvest.
completeFloraSupplement.statistics: Plant creature; no assumed language, mind immunity or world-origin claim. AC 12, HP 5+owner PB snapshotted at creation; saves +owner PB, other checks +0. No damage/condition immunities or special senses unless an actual source grants them. It perceives commands within 60 ft through ordinary sight/hearing; Silence matters for spoken commands. It has no independent initiative, Action, Bonus Action or Reaction, and no attack outside the commanded profiles or the final expressly bounded Trapcasting exception. Zero HP permanently destroys it instead of creating a dying body. No corpse, reward, harvest, resource/soul collection, loot or Supply credit. Ordinary legal damage and healing may affect the actual creature but cannot recreate a destroyed plant, refill its creation entitlement or extend its deadline.
completeFloraSupplement.dc: At acquisition select one actual possessed spellcasting route; use DC 8+current PB+that route’s current ability modifier. No phantom Wisdom/Spellcraft statistic. Actual source-specific component/target defenses still apply.
completeFloraSupplement.cadence: Action creates;1/SR or LR, capacity 1 or 2 at 10. NEW level 10 completion: after the first creation, one additionalAction before that first seedling expires may create the second without a second rest use. This one extra creation entitlement is bound to that original committed use and is consumed once; if missed/lost it is not banked. Each plant has its own original minute deadline. No replacement/revival can restore the entitlement. Any command, trap orBurst with a hostile result uses the owner’s one shared offensive-companion allowance per numbered round; one selected mode outcome for the coordinated group. Ordinary command: owner shared Bonus Action, actual perceptible60ft channel, attached phase after owner regular turn. One action outcome and one offensive allowance per owner/numbered round; Trapcasting spends that same allowance at its exact entry/burst event. No independent turn is added.
completeFloraSupplement.endpoints: Poisoned/Restrained records also end if the generating plant ends; no concentration is required. Reapplying same profile follows ordinary nonstacking rules. Burst consumes one body before resolving a 10 ft-radius area, all creaturesDEXsave,2d6 selectedtype half on success. Chosenmode/type doesnotchange aftercreation. No destroyed body can command or trap during the resolving event.
completeFloraSupplement.commandChoice: Every seedling may use the printed Lash command. Its selected creation mode additionally determines its Spore or Entangle option and its Trapcasting result/burst type; selecting Lash leaves that basic profile. A coordinated command chooses only one permitted outcome from one actual participating plant. Other plants extend the legal Lash origin as printed but never multiply damage, control areas or offense allowances.

conjure_flora.name: Conjure Flora

originalObject.name: Conjure Flora
originalObject.description: Seeds answer your call, rooting as guardians, lashing as spears, blooming as verdict. Prestige lineage: Verdant Animist. completed from the existing development record.)
originalObject.effect: Once per short rest, you conjure one immobile plant spirit (seedling) within 30 feet for 1 minute. It can lash for thorn damage, release spores, or entangle a 10-foot square. You may maintain one additional seedling at level 10+. As a bonus action, you may command all active seedlings to lash one creature within 10 feet of any seedling for 1d6 piercing damage (save for half).
originalObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.
originalObject.legacyEffect: Once per short rest, you conjure one immobile plant spirit (seedling) within 30 feet for 1 minute. It can lash for thorn damage, release spores, or entangle a 10-foot square. You may maintain one additional seedling at level 10+. As a bonus action, you may command all active seedlings to lash one creature within 10 feet of any seedling for 1d6 piercing damage (save for half).

conjure_flora.additionalUniversalAcquisitionGate: One actual unspent class-scheduled ASI/feat opportunity or separately authorized feat grant; prerequisite success never creates a choice.
conjure_flora.completeOperativeProcedure:
Once per beneficial SR/LR use an Action to create one of the three complete NEW seedling profiles below on visible supported ground within 30 ft and line of effect. It lasts one minute on original source-start markers, needs no concentration, and is a magical nonspell conjured body. Capacity is 1, or 2 at total level 10. NEW to make the second-capacity clause usable, at level 10 this same committed use permits one additional Action before the first plant expires to create one second plant; no second rest use, no later replacement of that spent creation. This is an explicit proposed addition to the printed one-seedling creation, not a recovered rule. Each plant gets its own minute. Choose its mode/burst type at creation. One BA may command all active plants within 60 ft able to perceive you, but produces only ONE selected mode outcome per round under the shared offensive-companion allowance. Lash chooses one creature within 10 ft of any participating plant for 1d6 piercing, DEX save half. Spore and entangle use their full profiles. No autonomous turn, opportunity attacks, harvest, loot, Supply, corpse or resource-generating death. Destruction/expiry permanently consumes the body.
NEW ordinary command scheduling: each plant has one attached phase immediately after its owner’s regular turn, not an independent initiative turn. Its ordinary commanded action requires the owner’s shared Bonus Action within60ft through the specified perceivable command channel and spends the one offensive companion allowance per owner per numbered round if offensive. With no legal command it has no autonomous attack. Trapcasting’s explicitly adopted entry-trigger or burst is a separate narrow exception spending that same shared offensive allowance, never another free attack.
KEEP the already-operative SUP-07 floraBody/dc acquisition requirement: at acquisition permanently select and record one actual possessed spellcasting route as this feat's DC provider. Use DC 8 + current PB + that route's current casting-ability modifier; do not invent Wisdom, Spellcraft or another default. This source choice is separate from the later seedling mode/burst-type choice. Ownership initializes only the finite creation allowance and body capacity, with no plant, pending additional creation, command or active effect. All printed acquisition predicates and the actual earned feat opportunity remain required.
conjure_flora.requirementsStatus: Source-derived finite validation contract; actual positive/negative actor histories still require testing.
conjure_flora.sourceDecision: Adopt three closed finite plant profiles with actual attached command phases and capacity/creation entitlements; no anonymous autonomous attack, corpse, harvest or class minion grant.

trapcasting.name: Trapcasting

originalObject.name: Trapcasting
originalObject.description: Roots, thorns, and spore-mines—you sow violence that waits patiently to bloom. Prestige lineage: Verdant Animist. completed from the existing development record.)
originalObject.effect: Your conjured flora count as magical traps. Enemies moving through a seedling's square must succeed on a Dexterity save or suffer its effect (damage, restraint, or poison). You can detonate one seedling as a bonus action for a Bloom Burst (10-foot area, 2d6 damage, type chosen at conjuring).
originalObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.
originalObject.legacyEffect: Your conjured flora count as magical traps. Enemies moving through a seedling's square must succeed on a Dexterity save or suffer its effect (damage, restraint, or poison). You can detonate one seedling as a bonus action for a Bloom Burst (10-foot AoE, 2d6 damage, type chosen at conjuring).

trapcasting.additionalUniversalAcquisitionGate: One actual unspent class-scheduled ASI/feat opportunity or separately authorized feat grant; prerequisite success never creates a choice.
trapcasting.completeOperativeProcedure:
Conjure Flora OR Verdant Bond qualifies for acquisition, but this feat supplies no missing plants. NEW only actual Conjure Flora profiles below qualify until another source is reviewed. At creation optionally arm a plant’s square as a magical trap using its fixed mode/burst type. Each meaningful hostile’s first actual entry in that square per numbered round, including forced entry but not plant placement, makes DEX save against flora DC; failure applies the profile’s trap result, success none. A legal trigger commits the owner’s shared offensive-companion allowance even on a save; if already spent by a command/other trap, no new trap activation occurs that round. One entrance cannot multiply across plants. Plants are visible, not automatically hidden: Action INT(Investigation) vs flora DC identifies an armed mode; Action DEX with actual thieves’ tools vs same DC disarms one trap without destroying its body, failure gives no automatic explosion. Alternatively, BA consumes one active plant within 60 ft you perceive with line of effect for a 10 ft-radius Bloom Burst at its space: all creatures DEX save,2d6 fixed piercing/poison damage, half success. Same offensive allowance; body ends before burst, cannot also command, and never refunds creation.
NEW phase exception is explicit: its first eligible hostile-entry attack may occur on that actual entry outside the ordinary attached phase, but spends the same owner-round offensive companion allowance immediately. Its paid burst likewise spends that allowance; neither can occur when it is already spent. Placement itself is not an entry-trigger unless this exact procedure expressly says so. General Conjure Flora commands retain their attached phase, shared Bonus Action and sensory channel.
trapcasting.requirementsStatus: Source-derived finite validation contract; actual positive/negative actor histories still require testing.
trapcasting.sourceDecision: Adopt entry-trigger/burst exceptions explicitly spending the same one owner-round offensive-companion allowance as ordinary plant commands; no simultaneous free offense or recreated plants.

verdant_bond.name: Verdant Bond

originalObject.name: Verdant Bond
originalObject.description: The green speaks to you in sap and silence. You answer with growth. Prestige lineage: Verdant Animist. completed from the existing development record.)
originalObject.effect: You can communicate simple ideas to plants within 60 feet and sense coarse emotions from rooted life (fear, hunger, dormancy). While you have at least one conjured flora active, you gain +1 to spell save DC and attack rolls for nature spells, and difficult terrain from nonmagical plants does not cost you extra movement. You have advantage on Nature checks in wilderness terrain. Once per long rest, you may ask a stand of plants to hold a memory for 24 hours—a whispered name, direction, or warning that replays when an ally you designate passes within 10 feet.

verdant_bond.additionalUniversalAcquisitionGate: One actual unspent class-scheduled ASI/feat opportunity or separately authorized feat grant; prerequisite success never creates a choice.
verdant_bond.completeOperativeProcedure:
While conscious, exchange brief simple ideas with actual plants within 60 ft you perceive and have line of effect to, using ordinary communication; receive only coarse current fear, hunger, dormancy, not language, intelligence, visions, identity records or omniscient history. A plant may be unresponsive; compel nothing. Gain advantage on actual Nature checks in wilderness terrain, with normal work/senses. While at least one Conjure Flora seedling remains active, gain+1 spell attack/DC under the NEW finite Nature predicate: spells actually cast through your Druid, Ranger or Shaman route, excluding copied profiles; no alias from a plant-themed name. Distinct eligible flat feat bonuses add under FS-03; this same feat contributes only once. In that same active-flora state, difficult terrain caused solely by nonmagical plants costs normal movement; other causes/hazards remain. Once LR spend one uninterrupted minute at a real rooted stand within reach to store a brief message of at most 25 words and one designated known ally identity. For 24 elapsed hours, the first time that ally passes within 10 ft the stand whispers it audibly once and ends the record. Others can hear normally; no remote confirmation or extracted plant memory. Destroying the stand ends the message; no new sentience or cosmology is asserted.
SOURCE ally scope: the owner may be the one chosen message recipient. It triggers on that recipient’s first genuinely future qualifying passage after recording, not immediate creation beside the tree; the audible stored message is not private telepathy or general tree fluency.

scope: Paid-source-to-body creation, conditional command/trap/burst state, one shared offense, source DC, binary saves and selected lifecycle conservation. Native damage outputs are before ordinary defenses; condition records do not execute every action restriction.
limits: Actual world, sound/sight, meaningful opposition, target/body positions, supported squares, completed action/escape/disarm facts and canonical clock/rest identities are explicit conditional premises, not authenticated campaigns.

All positions lie on one axis. Arbitrary geometry, movement, attacks against plant AC, passive damage defenses, owner/target whole HP/Wound engines and actual inventory/cargo are outside this bounded slice.

Command commitment and its one immediately following attached phase are a single bounded operation. Interruption between command and phase, suppressed source resumption and owner death need governing interfaces; no generic alternate rule is implied.

Lost casting-provider use and creating the second plant after the first is destroyed/uprooted before its original minute endpoint remain explicit source-adjudication questions. The model declines those unimplemented cases without declaring them illegal game actions.

Verdant Bond actual message and Nature-route effects, enemy identification of armed mode, full virtual-marker scheduler and no-resource integration remain separate finite work. No complete FXC04/09 closure or exact feat approval is claimed.
